summary: Example task backs up the IronWare config with ironware_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up an IronWare device config?

answer_card.title: Back up IronWare config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (ironware)
  community.network.ironware_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_ironware_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.ironware'
```
